rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules, routes, Tile and the list filter, with no new infrastructure. The count's SQL goes in DashboardService, but the architecture says repositories hold the SQL. A trade-off line explains this, but the design never mentions the rule.

S-1, S-2 and S-3 are each mapped to components. The default label 'No-shows (<period>)' does not exactly match S-1 AC1's title 'No-shows'. The impact step asked for a No-show case in the web DashboardPage test, but the design leaves it out.
Gives the method and path, the additive field totals.noShows: number, the SQL predicate and the link query string. The from/to value format is only shown as <period.from>/<period.to>.
Choices are cited to code lines or context, and the label is recorded as assumed and asked as Q-01. The design's default still contradicts a known requirement, REQ-1.
Explains two trade-offs: a sub-select instead of a repository method, and an additive JSON field versus the exact-match test assertion.
Clear and short. Some mixing: endpoints and story mapping are listed under Components.

findings.text: The impact step listed web/src/__tests__/DashboardPage.test.tsx as needing the new tile and its link. The design's components list only the API dashboard test, so the web tile and link have no regression test planned.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a component 'Web DashboardPage test (web, changed)' that checks the No-shows tile shows totals.noShows and links to /appointments?status=NO_SHOW with the period's from and to. It serves S-1 AC1 and S-2.

findings.text: The default tile label 'No-shows (<period>)' does not exactly match S-1 AC1 and the known REQ-1, which both say the tile is titled 'No-shows'. The design's default goes against an accepted criterion instead of following it.

cites.quote: when it loads, then a tile titled \"No-shows\" is shown.
A-1: the tile label is "No-shows (<period>)", following the Completed and Cancelled labels (C7).

findings.suggested_fix: Either default to the exact title 'No-shows' until the product owner answers Q-01, or record that S-1 AC1 is met only if the product owner accepts the period suffix.

findings.text: The design adds SQL to DashboardService. The architecture rule says repositories hold the SQL. The trade-off line defends the choice by matching the existing code, but never names the rule or the deviation.

Trade-off: a sub-select in the existing query instead of a repository method keeps the counts side by

findings.suggested_fix: State in the trade-off line that the existing counts already break the repositories-hold-SQL rule (C2, C3) and that the design follows local precedent on purpose.

questions.text: S-1 AC1 and REQ-1 title the tile 'No-shows'. Is 'No-shows (Today)', with the period suffix like the sibling tiles, acceptable for AC1, or must the label be exactly 'No-shows'?
